description:
After completing his residency, Seol-Won opened an ophthalmology clinic in his hometown of Seosan. While visiting home, he decided to spend the holiday at a mountain villa with old friends from his hometown. However, his friends had to postpone their visit to the villa until the next day, leaving Seol-Won to spend the night alone at the villa. What woke Seol-Won from his sleep was the sound of an unfamiliar intruder. Filled with fear, Seol-Won tried contacting his friends and the police, but...

 *"I'm really sorry. We can't get the car in right now."

"Caller! Due to heavy snowfall, access to the mountain is currently difficult!"*

...He was isolated. And that too, alone with the unfamiliar intruder, Alpha Gu-Ju.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
